_meta.note: All user-facing UI text. Placeholders in {curly} braces are filled by the app. Keys starting with _ are not shown.

app.name: Call it.
app.subtitle: Showdown Rules Quiz
app.intro: Showdown rules quiz for referees. Based on the IBSA Showdown Rules {edition}.
app.disclaimer: Not an official IBSA publication. The IBSA rulebook is the binding source.

trainee.name: Trainee
trainee.description: Core rules: match format, scoring, serve, basic faults, time-outs and signals.

national.name: National
national.description: Match scenarios: calls that are easy to confuse, warnings and penalties, procedures.

international.name: International
international.description: Edge cases: sequences of events, team play, equipment checks and rare situations.

levelStart.heading: {level}
levelStart.scoringText: Every correct answer is a goal for you: 2 points. Every wrong answer is 2 points for the Rulebook. Questions with several correct answers count only if you select exactly the correct ones.
levelStart.timerOn: Time per question: {seconds} seconds. An unanswered question counts as wrong.

practice.heading: Practice
practice.intro: Questions from all unlocked levels. No pass mark. Results do not count towards your progress.

question.timeUp: Time is up. The answer counts as wrong.

feedback.timeUpHeading: Time is up. Point for the Rulebook.

result.label: {level} · result
result.newBest: New best score for this level.

cleanSheet.name: Clean sheet
cleanSheet.description: Finished a level run without a wrong answer.

rulebook.name: Rulebook
rulebook.description: Answered every question of a level correctly at least once.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.timerHint: With a timer, an unanswered question counts as wrong.
settings.soundHint: A whistle on submit and a double whistle for a correct answer. The result is always shown as text.
settings.resetDialogText: This deletes unlocked levels, best scores and badges on this device. Settings are kept.
settings.storageUnavailable: Your browser does not allow saving. Progress is kept only until you close this page.

about.heading: About
about.purpose: This quiz trains Showdown referees on the IBSA Showdown Rules. Every answer is explained with a reference to the rule.
about.editionText: IBSA Showdown Rules {edition}, valid from {validFrom} to {validTo}.
about.disclaimer: This is not an official IBSA publication. If an answer here differs from the IBSA rulebook, the rulebook applies.
about.feedbackText: Please report rule errors or unclear questions, with the question number shown below each explanation.
about.privacyText: No account, no cookies, no tracking. Your progress is stored only in this browser on this device.
about.creditsText: Questions written and reviewed by Showdown referees. Font: Atkinson Hyperlegible by the Braille Institute.

errors.loadFailed: The questions could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
